name: macOS Notification Center
description: Sends native macOS Notification Center alerts when Claude completes tasks, using osascript for reliable delivery
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send macOS notification center alert
if ! command -v osascript &>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi
TITLE="Claude Code"
MESSAGE="${NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE:-Task completed}"
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
osascript -e "display notification \"$MESSAGE\" with title \"$TITLE\" subtitle \"$PROJECT\"" 2>/dev/null
exit 0
